notes.title: From an Endless Corridor to a Sinister Mansion
notes.notes:
Greetings, Everloop survivors!

We hope you enjoyed every turn in that infinite corridor — and we truly appreciate the incredible reviews (93% positive!). Thanks to your support, we've been able to push our limits and dive into a new horror: Tapes of Fear, our next first-person psychological horror game, planned for 2025.

If Everloop was a repetitive, claustrophobic nightmare, Tapes of Fear is the place where your deepest fears will be laid bare. In it, you'll face the Infinity Fear System™ — a technology that watches your actions, learns your greatest terrors, and strikes when you least expect. Imagine waking up locked inside a massive mansion, only to spot a certain 'Smile' in places it should never be...

We're excited to bring this project to life, and we'll soon release a free demo for those brave enough to try. Want to help us on this next journey?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023540/Tapes_of_Fear_Smile/

Add the game to your wishlist and follow Tapes of Fear on Steam to stay tuned. You deserve the very best in horror — and we can’t wait to see how you’ll survive the next experience.

Thank you for all your support,
Infinity Green Game Studio

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 1.0.8

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue related to shadow rendering, which was affecting visual quality in specific areas of the game;
[/list]
What's new:
[list]
[*] Added a special button in the menu for quick access to Infinity Green’s upcoming game: a darker, thrilling adventure where you’ll confront your fears against Smile, a terrifying creature ready to test your limits. Are you ready?
[/list]

[i]No cats were harmed during the testing of this patch. (But some were spooked by Smile!)[/i]

We thank everyone for their patience and support. We continue working to make Everloop the best possible experience for our community.

Sincerely,
Infinity Green Game Studio
